title: Sum Over All Subsets
statement: For each of the $1024$ subsets of $\{1, 2, \dots, 10\}$, add up its elements (the empty set has sum $0$). What is the total of all these sums?
insight: Swap the order of summation: each element appears in exactly 2^9 subsets, so the total is 512·(1+…+10).
redHerring: Grouping subsets by size and summing over each size.
hints: Instead of going subset by subset, go element by element.
In how many subsets does the element 7 appear?
solution: Count each element's contribution: element $k$ appears in $2^9 = 512$ subsets (choose freely whether each other element is in). Total $= 512\cdot(1+\dots+10) = 512\cdot55 = 28{,}160$.
